findings.evidence: `SpecialLinear/Basic.lean:247` defines `groupSchemeι`, while the new declaration at line 258 merely composes it with the named general-linear presentation.
findings.fix: Move it to `SpecialLinear/Basic.lean` beside `groupSchemeι`, adding the minimal import needed for `GeneralLinear.groupScheme_def`; keep only the factorization theorem here.
